fullText.simplified:
第二十三章、天花病毒

    族人阿提得了传染病，迷迷糊糊地躺在床上。这一切发生得太突然了，石文谦想第一时间把阿提隔离起来，却遭到了族人们的反对。
    这时候，扎格布尔抓住自己的拐杖，用力地在地上敲了几下，严肃地说：“先按照石文谦说的做！”他顿了顿，然后又补充了一句，“除了接触过阿提的人，其他人都跟我来，我要弄清楚到底是怎么回事！”
    在族长的帐篷内，站着几个人。他们都在向族长扎格布尔说着自己知道的情况。石文谦和简西站在扎格布尔的旁边，他们在努力地从这些信息中找到病情的根源。
    “族长，阿提之前跟两个族人一起去外面买过东西，他是自己一个人回来的。”
    “是的，阿提是和我们两个人一起去的。回来的时候阿提认识了一个大老板，大老板说想跟阿提做朋友，留阿提在他那儿住了一晚。我们两个人就先回来了，阿提没跟我们一起回来。”
    “阿提回来后，就说自己身体不舒服，在家里休息来着。”
    “听说他一直发烧，还头疼，我们以为就是普通的感冒。”
    “族长，阿提一直在发烧，身上还疼，听说他身上有水泡。族里的医生给阿提看过病，刚开始医生以为休息几天就会有好转。”
    “后来……后来医生又去的时候，发现水泡越来越多，一片一片的，有的还是紫红色的。再后来阿提就开始不清醒了，这肯定不是普通的病。”
    ……
    石文谦听着大家的话，觉得这和自己之前判断的差不多，他开口说道：“大家听我说，阿提可能是在村子外感染了病毒。我判断这是一种叫天花的病毒，刚开始的时候病人会发烧头疼，身上起水泡，后来就会像阿提现在这样。如果再严重，可能是会死人的！”
    石文谦看了看大家，又接着叮嘱道：“你们要相信我，这是传染病，接触过阿提的人一定要隔离，而且大家都要小心，小心，再小心！不仅如此，我们还要找医生，让外面专业的医生来这里给阿提治疗。”
    族人们你看看我，我看看你，不知道该怎么办，真的要按照石文谦说的做吗？族长扎格布尔也犹豫了，因为这样就意味着“河洛村”将不再是一个秘密的地方，渐渐地外面的人都会知道这里。他们辛辛苦苦守护的村子，可能会面临很多危险，甚至不得不被迁走。扎格布尔知道，他们绝不能搬走，这是他们祖祖辈辈守护的地方，还有他们一直守护的秘密……
fullText.traditional:
第二十三章、天花病毒

    族人阿提得了傳染病，迷迷糊糊地躺在床上。這一切發生得太突然了，石文謙想第一時間把阿提隔離起來，卻遭到了族人們的反對。
    這時候，札格布爾抓住自己的拐杖，用力地在地上敲了幾下，嚴肅地說：“先按照石文謙說的做！”他頓了頓，然後又補充了一句，“除了接觸過阿提的人，其他人都跟我來，我要弄清楚到底是怎麼回事！”
    在族長的帳篷內，站著幾個人。他們都在向族長札格布爾說著自己知道的情況。石文謙和簡西站在札格布爾的旁邊，他們在努力地從這些信息中找到病情的根源。
    “族長，阿提之前跟兩個族人一起去外面買過東西，他是自己一個人回來的。”
    “是的，阿提是和我們兩個人一起去的。回來的時候阿提認識了一個大老闆，大老闆說想跟阿提做朋友，留阿提在他那兒住了一晚。我們兩個人就先回來了，阿提沒跟我們一起回來。”
    “阿提回來後，就說自己身體不舒服，在家裡休息來著。”
    “聽說他一直發燒，還頭疼，我們以為就是普通的感冒。”
    “族長，阿提一直在發燒，身上還疼，聽說他身上有水泡。族裡的醫生給阿提看過病，剛開始醫生以為休息幾天就會有好轉。”
    “後來……後來醫生又去的時候，發現水泡越來越多，一片一片的，有的還是紫紅色的。再後來阿提就開始不清醒了，這肯定不是普通的病。”
    ……
    石文謙聽著大家的話，覺得這和自己之前判斷的差不多，他開口說道：“大家聽我說，阿提可能是在村子外感染了病毒。我判斷這是一種叫天花的病毒，剛開始的時候病人會發燒頭疼，身上起水泡，後來就會像阿提現在這樣。如果再嚴重，可能是會死人的！”
    石文謙看了看大家，又接著叮囑道：“你們要相信我，這是傳染病，接觸過阿提的人一定要隔離，而且大家都要小心，小心，再小心！不僅如此，我們還要找醫生，讓外面專業的醫生來這裡給阿提治療。”
    族人們你看看我，我看看你，不知道該怎麼辦，真的要按照石文謙說的做嗎？族長札格布爾也猶豫了，因為這樣就意味著“河洛村”將不再是一個秘密的地方，漸漸地外面的人都會知道這裡。他們辛辛苦苦守護的村子，可能會面臨很多危險，甚至不得不被遷走。札格布爾知道，他們絕不能搬走，這是他們祖祖輩輩守護的地方，還有他們一直守護的秘密……

sentences.simplified: 他们辛辛苦苦守护的村子，可能会面临很多危险，甚至不得不被迁走。
sentences.traditional: 他們辛辛苦苦守護的村子，可能會面臨很多危險，甚至不得不被遷走。
sentences.pinyin: tā men xīn xīn kǔ kǔ shǒu hù de cūn zi kě néng huì miàn lín hěn duō wēi xiǎn shèn zhì bù dé bù bèi qiān zǒu
sentences.english: The village they had painstakingly protected may face many dangers, and may even have to be relocated.

sentences.simplified: 扎格布尔知道，他们绝不能搬走，
sentences.traditional: 札格布爾知道，他們絕不能搬走，
sentences.pinyin: zhā gé bù ěr zhī dào tā men jué bù néng bān zǒu
sentences.english: Zhage Bu’er knew that they could never move away.

sentences.simplified: 这是他们祖祖辈辈守护的地方，还有他们一直守护的秘密……
sentences.traditional: 這是他們祖祖輩輩守護的地方，還有他們一直守護的秘密……
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì tā men zǔ zǔ bèi bèi shǒu hù de dì fang hái yǒu tā men yì zhí shǒu hù de mì mì
sentences.english: This was the place their ancestors had guarded for generations, and there was also the secrets they had always guarded …

sentence_translations: Chapter 23: Smallpox Virus
Clan member Ati contracted an infectious disease and lay in bed in a daze.
Everything happened so suddenly. Shi Wenqian wanted to isolate Ati immediately but was opposed by the clan members.
At this moment, Zhage Bu’er grabbed his cane and knocked it hard on the ground a few times and said solemnly, ..
.. “For now, do as Shi Wenqian said!”
He paused for a moment, then added, “Except those who have been in contact with Ati, everyone come with me.
I want to figure out what’s going on!”
A few people were standing inside the chieftain’s tent. They were all telling the chieftain Zhage Bu’er what they knew.
Shi Wenqian and Jian Xi stood next to Zhage Bu’er.
They were working hard to find out the root cause of the disease from this information.
“Chieftain, Ati previously went out to buy things with two other members of the clan, and he came back alone.”
“Yes, Ati went with the two of us. On the way back, Ati met a big boss.
The big boss said he wanted to be friends with Ati and let Ati stay at his place for one night.
The two of us came back first. Ati didn’t come back with us.”
“After Ati came back, he said he wasn’t feeling well and was resting at home.”
“We heard that he had been constantly running a fever and that his head hurt. We thought it was just a common cold.”
“Chieftain, Ati had been constantly running a fever and also had body aches. I heard that he had blisters on his body.
The doctor in the village treated Ati. At first, the doctor thought that a few days of rest would lead to an improvement.”
“Later … later when the doctor went again, he found that there were more and more blisters.
There were patches of blisters. Some of them were even purplish-red.
Later, Ati began to lose consciousness. This is definitely not an ordinary illness.”
Shi Wenqian listened to what everyone said and felt that this was about the same as what he had previously thought.
He began to speak, “Everyone, listen to me. Ati may have been infected with a virus outside the village.
I think this is a virus called smallpox.
At the start, the patient will have a fever and headache, and blisters will appear on the body.
Later on, it will be like what Ati is experiencing now. If it gets any worse, the person might die!”
Shi Wenqian looked around at everyone and then continued to admonish, “You must believe me. This is an infectious disease.
Anyone who has been in contact with Ati must be quarantined. And everyone must be extremely cautious!
Not only that, we also need to find a doctor. We need to get a professional doctor from outside to come here to treat Ati.”
The members of the clan looked at each other, not knowing what to do. Should they really do as Shi Wenqian said?
Chieftain Zhage Bu’er also hesitated, because this meant that “Heluo Village” would no longer be a secret place.
Gradually, people from the outside would come to know about this place.
The village they had painstakingly protected may face many dangers, and may even have to be relocated.
Zhage Bu’er knew that they could never move away.
This was the place their ancestors had guarded for generations, and there was also the secrets they had always guarded …
